visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a grey sleeveless turtleneck top, sits on a bed with white sheets and a pillow featuring a dog print. She holds small white boxes and speaks with an expressive mouth and wide eyes toward the camera. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the neutral-toned room. (2) The scene cuts to a closer shot of the woman pointing her right index finger toward her right eye while smiling. (3) She returns to the medium shot, gesturing with one finger and then a peace sign to list points of discussion. (4) The scene transitions to the interior lobby of a clinic; a gold 'Vision Eye Center' logo is mounted on a marble-textured wall behind two masked receptionists. (5) A technical close-up shows a human eye being scanned by a medical laser system with 'SMILE Pro 2.0' and '全飛秒' text overlays. (6) The woman walks through glass sliding doors into the clinic, then stands in front of a floor-to-ceiling window overlooking the city from a high-rise building. (7) Various shots show the modern clinic interior with brown leather booths, circular LED ceiling lights, and professional diagnostic equipment. (8) The woman undergoes pre-operative checks, leaning her chin into various white scanning machines while a male staff member in a dark suit assists her. (9) In a consultation room, a doctor in a white lab coat points at a computer monitor displaying green corneal topographical maps to the woman. (10) Transition to the surgery room: the woman lies on a surgical bed under a large machine emitting blue light, with surgical drapes partially covering her face. (11) A surgeon wearing a blue cap and mask operates on the eye using a specialized microscope and laser equipment. (12) After the procedure, the woman is back on the bed in the original setting, gesturing with open palms and a joyful expression, wearing a silver watch. (13) Brief clips show her in an elevator with a man and standing outdoors in a city environment without glasses. (14) The video concludes with shots of an award plaque from Newsweek and a group photo of the clinic's medical team.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Process -> Evidence -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for the SMILE Pro 2.0 eye surgery at Vision Eye Center (遠見眼科). It follows a personal journey from the inconvenience of high myopia and contact lenses to the ease and success of the surgery, using technical footage and award recognition to build credibility.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation of the clinic name, filming on-site, and detailing the specific medical technology and doctor.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-production social media format with fast-paced editing and detailed subtitles to maintain engagement. It combines personal emotional appeals with medical authority (Dr. Zhang and Newsweek awards) to minimize viewer apprehension about eye surgery.
